proposal.expected_reason: RL policy evaluation with medium-seed-0 on F_competition will return a verified complete-batch Makespan different from 63.0 s; if it is lower, the CP plateau is method-specific, and if it is equal or higher, 63.0 s is likely near-optimal for this instance.
proposal.selection_reason: Round-003 showed that tripling the CP-SAT budget from 1 s to 3 s produced no improvement and no bound tightening on F_competition, so further CP budget increases on the same encoding are poor value. The cheapest untried method on this scenario is RL policy evaluation with an allowed pretrained model. RL explores a different schedule space than the exact CP encoding and may escape the 63.0 s plateau. The estimated experiment cost is about 10 s, within the remaining wall budget and the 40 s per-experiment cap. This also begins mapping method performance on F_competition, which is needed before comparing tool cost across methods.
